glossary.definition: (1) "Goods or services" does not include the creation, dissemination, exhibition, or advertisement, or a similar promotion, of a dramatic, literary, musical, political, journalistic, or artistic work.
glossary.source_title: Section 2747.01 - Application of the Uniform Public Expression Protection Act - definitions.

glossary.definition: (2) "Governmental unit" means the government of the United States, the state, a political subdivision of the state, or any department, agency, board, commission, or other instrumentality of the government of the United States, the state, or a political subdivision.
glossary.source_title: Section 2747.01 - Application of the Uniform Public Expression Protection Act - definitions.
